title: Medieval Iberian Manuscripts & Digital Humanities

sections.abstract: Clara Evans proposes high-resolution multispectral imaging of 14th-century bilingual Toledo manuscripts housed in the Beinecke Rare Book & Manuscript Library.
sections.scientific_methodology: Spectral reflectance imaging combined with digital paleography to recover damaged palimpsest text.
sections.impact_and_dissemination: Digital open repository curated at Beinecke Library for international medievalists.
sections.work_packages: Archives review, multispectral scanning, transcription, and scholarly apparatus.
sections.budget: Covers archival travel and specialized spectral camera lens rental.

video_transcript: Hello. I am Clara Evans. My archival research at the Beinecke explores cross-cultural Iberian history.
